objective: Test the already quality-bounded online byte-diversity guard as the sole collapse controller after the retained post-generation lexical truncator was measured to violate byte-target completion.

controlling_evidence.measured_interaction: The online guard passed repetition and diversity gates, while the post-generation lexical truncator alone caused all three short outputs.

decision_rule: Promote only if one exact candidate passes identity, physical sparsity, all 1,400 validation observations, and all 120 repeated benchmark observations. Reject rather than modify either byte-guard value or add another decoder control.
claim_boundary: This corrects controller composition only. It does not add acquired knowledge, teacher material, or task-specific behavior.
